summary: Rescue and firefighting cover at EGUN reduced to amber level, with three vehicles carrying 7,600 gallons of extinguishing agent.
text:
RFFS CAPABILITY AMBER, 03 VEHICLES/7600 GALLONS OF AGENT REDUCING

PROTECTION ASSOCIATION (NFPA) CAT 8 (KC-135, C-17, KC-46, B-1, B-2, 
B-52, 767). NFPA CAT 9 (KC-10, E-4, MD-11, 747, 777, VC-25) AND 
NFPA CAT 10 (C5, 787-8I) ARE AT REDUCED LVL OF SER. NFPA CAT 7 
(RC-135, CV-22, C-130) REMAIN OPTIMUM LEVEL OF SER.
